youtube_description:
The Ghost Writing AI Project is now live!

Our aim is to create new works of fiction based off the works of classic science fiction and landmark historical fiction - using artificial intelligence.

We will be updating the channel with videos on our progress, in addition to historical videos on the history of machine writing.

Subscribe, and join us on our journey.
